apocalypse-arrives-i-become-a-powerhouse:
Moira Lynch never expected that something like transmigration would happen to her.
At first, looking at her vast fortune, with no siblings to fight with and no dramatic relatives to contend with, she thought she had been handed a script for a life of idle leisure.
Just as Moira was preparing to embrace this life of ease, she discovered she was wrong.
Various natural disasters struck one after another, and without a system, Moira's world went dark.
Fortunately, although there was no system, having a spatial dimension was good enough, and Moira began her hoarding mode.
She originally thought that this relaxed life was not bad, but the sudden arrival of a game showed Moira a more vibrant and colorful world.
Looking at Caelus behind her, ravaged and scarred by natural disasters, Moira felt she had to do something.
Thus, Moira became a packrat, treating others' unwanted items as treasures and bringing them back to upgrade her people's equipment: Exoskeleton Mecha, Space Buttons, Flying Devices, spaceships...…
enlightenment-attaining-the-dao-at-age-8:
Li Chang'an transmigrates into a world where every human undergoes universal reincarnation.
When they turn eighteen, each person is granted one temporary reincarnation into a trial world.
Succeed in defying fate, and you become a revered, officially recognized Extraordinary Reincarnator.
Fail… and you can only kneel at their feet, begging for protection—condemned to a lifetime with no hope of rising again.
But when Li Chang'an enters the Rebirth World for the first time, he discovers that he possesses an innate talent, Heaven-Defying Comprehension.
[Heaven-Defying Comprehension: You observe a martial artist’s dragon-like strides and tiger-like steps. Insight strikes—comprehended Body Technique: Shadowless Step!]
[Heaven-Defying Comprehension: You witness a duel between peerless swordmasters. A single sword stroke spans three thousand li, mighty as thunder from the heavens. Insight strikes—comprehended Sword Art: Thundering Thunderbolt Sword!]
[Heaven-Defying Comprehension: You have read three thousand Daoist classics, fused them with all martial arts under heaven, and created an Immortal Cultivation Method: Nine Heavens Star Art!]

villains-path-system:
Lucian Valemont was supposed to die a dog's death.
Humiliated. Discarded. Killed by the golden protagonist like every forgettable villain.
There was just one problem: he remembered the entire damn novel.
Reincarnated as the bastard son of Duke Valemont, Lucian wakes up with a Villain's Path System and a destiny written in failure. His talent? Stolen by a curse that sealed 88% of his mana. His family? They'd celebrate if he dropped dead. The academy? They see him as a punchline.
But Lucian has something the protagonist doesn't.
He knows exactly what's coming.
Every plot twist. Every hidden power. Every “destined” heroine who's supposed to fall for the hero.
Seraphina Ashenblade—the proud sword goddess with a secret no one suspects.
Elira Frostveil—the ice princess hiding a bloodline that could shatter kingdoms.
Aria Lighthollow—the saintly healer with desires darker than anyone knows.
The protagonist can have his spotlight and his predictable happy ending.
Lucian will take the power, the women, and the throne the story never meant for him to have.
The novel thinks it controls his fate.
It's about to learn what happens when the villain stops playing by the rules.…
